scientific_question: Does full-model fine-tuning on only source-adjudicated measured Ugi train products move generated exact-L1 precursor-role morphology closer to the group-balanced measured Ugi train-development reference than the frozen base checkpoint?
nonclaims: This is a seed-0 train-fold-only development re-adjudication, not a held-out or across-training-seed model claim.
The assay performs no training, generation, repair, retry, routing, oracle calls or candidate selection.
The panel reports directional consistency without a confidence interval or significance claim.

A successful held-in capacity diagnostic does not promote this checkpoint to production or support a manuscript result.
